content.rendered: You will not want to miss our Bingo Night on Thursday, March 15th from 6:00-7:30.  There will be prizes, pizza and $1 raffle tickets for a chance to win an overnight stay at Willamette Valley Vineyards.   This is a fun community event  to help support our 4th grade overnight Oregon Trail field trip.  We have some great prizes, but if any of our Middleton families would like to donate something or have connections with businesses that would be willing to donate prizes for kids and/or adults, we would be happy to accept them big or small.  Mark your calendars now and we will see you at Middleton on the 15th.  Doors open at 5:45.
